# 2 Baruch Chapter 43 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**43:1** Hear therefore this-word, all-you-who-dwell-upon-the-earth and-all-you-sons-of-Jacob: concerning-the-things which-I-am-about-to-speak to-you.

**43:2** Are-you-ignorant of-that to-which [we are summoned]? And-do-you-not-know what-has-been-deposited in-us?

**43:3** Now-therefore, let-each-of-you-who-has-received the-pure-law of-the-Most-High know that-the-age-is-a-time-for-sowing and-a-time-for-reaping; and-[know]-that-good-and-evil works-are-awaiting the-sower-and-the-one-who-reaps-them.

**43:4** And-take-heed concerning the-age to-come, and-fix-your-attention upon-your-immortal-hope — for-the-judgment-is-at-the-door, and-the-truth-of-the-law-is-fulfilling-itself.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Baruch addresses the people with exhortation. The agricultural metaphor of sowing and reaping (v.3) frames moral accountability. "Immortal hope" (v.4) refers to resurrection hope. The law "fulfilling itself" (v.4) echoes the law-as-judge theme of ch. 42.*
